blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Akbayan party-list Rep. Percival Cendaña has maintained that there is nothing libelous in the statements he made about Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) founder Apollo Quiboloy. Cendaña made the statement as the lawmaker filed his counter-affidavit to the cases against him. In an ambush interview on Friday, the lawmaker said that part of the counter-affidavit that he filed before the Pasig City Regional Trial Court contained transcripts of witnesses who testified against Quiboloy. The documents also included media reports. He reiterated that he merely echoed the contents of these papers in his statements. “We argued in our counter-affidavit that […]...
